name: Jarro

lines.text: Hear that? Strike the flag by the well and it rings hollow. Tan, the drivers call it -- the road's note. Where the ground rings like that, the road goes round.
Every stall on this rise pays the well a skin of water a season. I keep the well. So they pay me, and I keep the well. It is not complicated.
University people draw me a straight line across the basin every year and tell me I am losing a day. I give them a skin of water for the walk and they come back the long way.
So you walked it. -- Now you know why nobody here needs telling.

notes: Drafted 27 September 2026 for the owner to rewrite. The Caravan Ground's dada: nobody gave him the rise, he has simply kept its well longer than anyone has argued. Right about the road before the player is, and patient about it.
